name: linkedin-gtm
description: Run a LinkedIn B2B motion in three layers — content and authority (hook shapes, four content types, profile optimization, 1-of-1 positioning), warming (move prospects from cold to warm with engagement before any outreach), and outreach (decision-maker research, connection requests, a 4-message DM sequence, sell-by-chat, inbox triage) — on a 60-90 minute weekly rhythm with human approval on everything outbound, plus a profile conversion layer (headline/banner/featured/About/CTA), lead-magnet posts with comment-keyword delivery, and niche first-touch openers. Use for "LinkedIn GTM", "LinkedIn content plan", "LinkedIn outreach", "book calls from LinkedIn", "LinkedIn lead magnet post", or LinkedIn profile optimization.
